text: たたかい　には　せんりゃくが　ひつよう　なんだ　いった　とおり　やってる？

structure.jp: せんりゃくが　ひつよう　なんだ

patterns.name: 〜とおり
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by とおり means 'just as' that action went. いった　とおり = 'just as I said'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なんだ is the short spoken form of なのだ and gives the feeling of explaining how things are. ひつよう　なんだ = 'it's needed, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is being kept up; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. やってる = 'are doing'.
